exam_scheme.note: Gujarat Common Entrance Test (GUJCET) is conducted by the Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board (GSEB) for admissions into Degree Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) and Degree/Diploma Pharmacy (B.Pharm/D.Pharm) across universities and colleges in Gujarat.
